text: Kairos Cloud · Docs · Discord · Finic Kairos decides every sign-up, login, order, payment and payout as it happens, and keeps each decision with the signals behind it. It is an open-source alternative to Sardine, Sift, Riskified and SEON, with two things they don't have: your coding agent tunes it , and decision models catch fraud before you have the labels to train on. You send Kairos what happens in your product: sign-ups, logins, orders, payouts, chargebacks. It decides each request (approve, step up, review or block) and keeps every decision with the signals behind it. What makes Kairos different is who tunes it. Connect Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any agent over MCP , and the agent can do the work of a fraud ML engineer: You: "Our chargebacks went up. Find a better model for shopify_order and publish it if it wins." Agent: designs six variants → create_workflow_experiment → reads the results → "Logistic regression on the order's numbers plus Grayson's answers wins: ROC-AUC 0.949 on validation, 0.930 on test. Publishing it as v6." Decision models and traditional ML, together Kairos is built around Grayson , Finic's decision model. You ask it questions in plain language ("Does the shipping address look like a reshipper?", "Is this email throwaway?") and it answers with calibrated probabilities. Decision models are strong where traditional ML is weak: Traditional models are strong where decision models are weak: they learn your own outcomes precisely, from your own numbers, and they cost nothing per decision. Kairos lets you combine both: Grayson's answers become features next to your fields in a logistic regression or gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost-compatible, trained in Kairos itself), and experiments tell you which combination wins on your data. Sign up at kairos.finic.ai . Create a sandbox environment, a secret key, and you're ready to send events. In the console, open Settings › MCP , turn on the tool groups your agent needs, and create a key. Then, in Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http kairos https://kairos.finic.ai/mcp --header " Authorization: Bearer ksk_… " Cursor, Codex and VS Code work the same way: see MCP for agents . Then ask your agent to look at your decisions, build a workflow, or run an experiment. npm install @finic-ai/kairos # or: pip install finic-kairos import { Kairos } from "@finic-ai/kairos" ; const kairos = new Kairos ( { apiKey : process . env . KAIROS_API_KEY ! , baseUrl : "https://kairos.finic.ai" } ) ; await kairos . defineAction ( "withdrawal" , { subject : "user" , hold : "Should this withdrawal be held because the account shows signs of fraud or takeover?" , } ) ; kairos . track ( "login" , { userId : "user_42" , deviceId : "dev_9" , ipCountry : "GB" } ) ; const decision = await kairos . decide ( { type : "withdrawal" , userId : "user_42" , usd : 900 } ) ; // { decision: "approve" | "step_up" | "review" | "block", riskScore, reasons, … } Self-host You need Node.js 22, pnpm 10 and a Grayson API key from portal.finic.ai . No database to set up: the server starts its own Postgres. pnpm install cp .env.example .env # set GRAYSON_API_KEY pnpm kairos dev # the API on http://localhost:8787 and the console on http://localhost:5273 For your team, docker compose up --build . See Self-hosting and Local setup . pnpm kairos signup # the local server, a new account pnpm kairos login --profile prod --url https://kairos.finic.ai --email you@example.com pnpm kairos keys create " My server " # a secret key for your code pnpm kairos actions define withdrawal --data @withdrawal.json pnpm kairos import events transactions.csv --type transaction --ts created_at --entity user=customer pnpm kairos decide withdrawal -e user=user_42 -p usd=900 pnpm kairos workflows run review_payout -i user=user_42 --wait pnpm kairos --help # every command To have kairos on your path, run pnpm link --global in apps/cli . The docs are at kairos.finic.ai/docs , and in docs/ . pnpm test # all tests; no network pnpm test:python # the tests of the Python SDK pnpm typecheck Community Discord: questions, ideas and show-and-tell, at discord.gg/4zRwRCK6Mx Email: support@finic.ai Contributing: issues and pull requests are welcome.
